newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Assembly OKs $71 mln fire protection funds.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Assembly OKs $71 mln fire protection funds.

text.p: California's Assembly approved a $71 million measure on Thursday to pay for fire protection services across the state.
Assembly Bill 169 appropriates $71 million to the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection to pay for emergency services in the state.

"The citizens of California can now breath easier with the assurance that the state is once again able to adequately respond to emergencies," said Republican Assemblyman Tom Bordonaro, who authored the bill.
After receiving initial Assembly approval in March, the bill stalled in the Senate, where it was amended. The Assembly approved the amendments Thursday on a vote of 77-to-0.
Gov. Pete Wilson, a Republican, was expected sign the bill in the coming days, Bordonaro said.
